title: AC#1 blocker fixes: routes/common AllowAnonymous + PointToPoint coords/addresses in DTO
coverage_delta: +5 new tests (324 -> 329). FIX1: the 4 pre-existing CommonRoutesTests were updated in place to call an anonymous client (no AsCustomer(); only X-Fleet-Slug) to match the new public contract, plus a new explicit anonymous-success test and a no-fleet-resolved -> 404 guard test (mirrors PublicFleet_NoSlug_Returns404). FIX2: +1 test proving the DTO exposes PointToPoint coords+addresses, +1 proving those fields satisfy CreateOrderValidator via TestValidate, +1 regression proving a PointToPoint route with null dropoff coords omits the dropoff address so it still passes the validator. A/B anonymous isolation is covered by the updated CommonRoutes_CrossTenant_ReturnsOwnFleetOnly (now using the anonymous client). OpenAPI allowlist test (SeedAndEndToEndTests) passed unchanged because the path did not move.
notes: DECISION: kept the endpoint in Features/Routes and flipped CustomerOnly -> AllowAnonymous (minimal diff; path stays routes/common, Swagger tag stays Routes, allowlist untouched). Rejected relocating to Features/Public because it would change the Swagger tag (Routes->Public) and churn api.md for no functional gain; documented the anonymous-tenant rationale in the endpoint xmldoc mirroring GetFleetEndpoint/TrackByCodeEndpoint. ANONYMOUS TENANT: injected ICurrentTenant, added `currentTenant.FleetId is null -> 404` guard (Route is ITenantEntity so the EF filter yields EMPTY not a throw for a no-slug caller; without the guard an anonymous no-slug caller would get 200-empty instead of the 404 the public contract promises). Fleet resolved by TenantResolutionMiddleware from X-Fleet-Slug/subdomain for anonymous requests (same as public/fleet + public/track); query filter keeps it fleet-safe. geo/suggest + pricing/quote STAY CustomerOnly - only the listing is public. DTO ADDITIONS (all additive, all trailing-optional with default null so existing positional callers compile; each new param has a matching <param> doc to avoid CS1573 per the F-02 trap): PickupAddress, PickupLat, PickupLng, DropoffAddress, DropoffLat, DropoffLng, FromZoneId, ToZoneId. The Route ENTITY HAS NO ADDRESS COLUMNS (only Name + FromLat/FromLng/ToLat?/ToLng? + FromZoneId?/ToZoneId?) - so PickupAddress/DropoffAddress are populated from the route Name (a required/non-empty field on every route incl. seeded demo routes -> satisfies CreateOrder validator NotEmpty with zero migration and no seeder change). PointToPoint routes carry coords+addresses; Zone/ZoneToZone carry FromZoneId/ToZoneId and leave coords null (customer enters the in-zone address; coords come from geocoding). The real AC#1 blocker was pickup COORDS (validator requires non-zero PickupLat/PickupLng); web was stubbing 0 -> 400. No migration, no entity change, no seeder change. IMPORTANT dropoff-coords edge: ToLat/ToLng are nullable on the entity; DropoffAddress is set to the route Name ONLY when BOTH dropoff coords are non-null - because the CreateOrder validator requires DropoffLat/Lng NotNull When DropoffAddress is not null, so advertising a dropoff address with null coords would reintroduce a 400. A PointToPoint route with null dropoff coords surfaces pickup coords + null dropoff (pickup-only order, still valid). Seed route1 (Nadrazi -> Centrum) has non-null To-coords so it is unaffected. DEFERRED (pre-06, consistent with prior handoff's PointToPoint-only posture): zoneName is NOT exposed for Zone/ZoneToZone (only FromZoneId/ToZoneId GUIDs); the web cannot label a zone card from a GUID alone yet - add a zone-name join when the customer zone-order flow lands. AUTH NOTE: all 4 pre-existing tests were converted customer->anonymous; an authenticated-customer-without-slug path now relies on the middleware JWT branch exercised elsewhere (not re-asserted here) - low risk since AllowAnonymous is a superset. Did NOT touch web/** or .claude/state other than this handoff; staged only api/ docs/. No new CLAUDE.md trap (clean path on existing patterns).
